source: shop standard for this skill; no purchased part

standard_pad.note: Shop standard dowel pad: 40 x 40 centred on the pin, one plate thickness of ligament (5 mm) as on the clamp cap. Cheeks at +-12 mm leave room for a 12 mm cap tab beside the reamed hole. The dowel is pressed through the pad, so the pad thickness is the bearing length; a pad grown to suit is not standard.
